rulesStrings.li: questDescription->The Foundation offers SCP-914 in a large transport crate. Accept the assignment, then have two colonists carry and install it in a prepared, roofed room. The machine occupies 3 by 2 cells; its input and output require a total width of 5. Leave a clear 7 by 4 area around it and at least 35 cells in the room. Choose the installation position on the crate. The assignment ends when the machine is installed.

li.label: SCP-914 delivery lost
li.text: The transport crate was destroyed before installation.
